共同操作

A1

步骤 1：stir in oil bath

A2

加料顺序：imine；allenoate；Na2CO3；1.5 mL toluene；DBU in 0.5 mL toluene；通法出处：General Procedure ii；步骤 1：stir at 50 °C in an oil bath; monitor by TLC；步骤 2：quench with water (10 mL); extract aqueous layer with ethyl acetate (3 × 5 mL)；步骤 3：wash combined organic layer with brine; dry over anhydrous Na2SO4; concentrate under reduced pressure；步骤 4：silica gel column chromatography; ethyl acetate/hexane 10:90

A3

加料顺序：cyclic sulfamidate imine；PPh3；1.0 mL toluene；allenoate in 1.0 mL toluene over 30 min；通法出处：General Procedure iii；步骤 1：add δ-acetoxy allenoate solution gradually over 30 min；步骤 2：[4 + 2] annulation；步骤 3：quench with water (10 mL); extract the aqueous layer with ethyl acetate (3 × 5 mL)；步骤 4：wash the combined organic layer with brine; dry over anhydrous Na2SO4; concentrate under reduced pressure；步骤 5：silica gel column chromatography using ethyl acetate/hexane (30:70)

A4

加料顺序：cyclic sulfamidate imine；PPh3；1.0 mL toluene；allenoate in 1.0 mL toluene over 30 min；通法出处：General Procedure iv；步骤 1：add δ-acetoxy allenoate solution gradually over 30 min；步骤 2：[4 + 2] annulation；步骤 3：quench with water (10 mL); extract the aqueous layer with ethyl acetate (3 × 5 mL)；步骤 4：wash the combined organic layer with brine; dry over anhydrous Na2SO4; concentrate under reduced pressure；步骤 5：silica gel column chromatography using ethyl acetate/hexane (10:90)

A5

加料顺序：cyclic sulfonyl imine；allenoate；Na2CO3；1.5 mL toluene；DBU in 0.5 mL toluene；通法出处：General Procedure vi；步骤 1：one-pot [3 + 3] annulation in oil bath；步骤 2：quench with water (10 mL); extract the aqueous layer with ethyl acetate (3 × 5 mL)；步骤 3：wash the combined organic layer with brine; dry over anhydrous Na2SO4; concentrate under reduced pressure；步骤 4：silica gel column chromatography using ethyl acetate/hexane (5:95)

A6

加料顺序：cyclic sulfonyl imine；PPh3；1.0 mL toluene；allenoate in 1.0 mL toluene over 30 min at 80 °C；通法出处：General Procedure viii；步骤 1：add δ-acetoxy allenoate solution gradually over 30 min；步骤 2：[4 + 2] annulation；步骤 3：quench with water (10 mL); extract the aqueous layer with ethyl acetate (3 × 5 mL)；步骤 4：wash the combined organic layer with brine; dry over anhydrous Na2SO4; concentrate under reduced pressure；步骤 5：silica gel column chromatography using ethyl acetate/hexane (30:70)
